+Default ``FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS`` is now set
+------------------------------------------------
+
+:setting:`FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS` now defaults to ``0o644`` instead of
+``None``. Uploaded files that end up using ``TemporaryUploadedFile`` used to
+get permissions of ``0o600``, whereas files using ``InMemoryUploadedFile``
+received permissions based on the current system's umask setting. Now both
+cases result in ``0o644`` permissions, unless the setting is customized. If
+you rely on the old, inconsistent behavior, you can explicitly set
+:setting:`FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS` to ``None``.
+
